scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Self-Marriage of Registered Women Workers (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Must be a registered woman worker with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for at least one year
Must have an active membership with the Board
Must not have received marriage assistance for her own marriage from any other government department/board/corporation
Must submit an undertaking/self‑declaration confirming the above
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 is provided to registered women workers for arranging their own marriage.
